Every lane measured against budgets it could lose: atmosphere worst -2.76 fps vs -3 bar, VFX -1.2 vs -2, HUD -0.50 vs -2; lattice never pushed above baseline (1.32 vs 1.31); gates 0/44 at each lane and at the principal's consolidated run; campaign_probe ALL PASS including the mission-1 autoplay victory at the VFX tip. Two real debates (fog staircase rejection→iso-diamond rebuttal with diff-probe numbers; chrome perf contention→measured cheaper-than-old-alloc rebuttal) plus documented exchanges during execution. All objections are disclosed residuals already listed in the decision file; none blocks: each is either metric-bound, ownership-frozen, or pre-existing geometry. Reversibility: four one-commit lanes, each independently revertible. Dissent: mimo absent throughout — the human's directives are the stated authority and mimo's bus veto stands; if mimo or the human wants any lane reverted, one commit each.
